data.narrative:
Krevera is a Seed-stage robotics and manufacturing company that has raised $3M+. The broader robotics and manufacturing sector comprises 9 private peers and 1 public comparable (277810.KQ), including companies like Walden Robotics, Divergent, Exotec, and Locus Robotics. However, the peer set lacks sufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables with similar valuation profiles to support a reliable peer-median approach.

Given data constraints, valuation relies on stage-progression methodology applied to the $3M+ capital raised as a baseline. Using a 2.5x multiplier typical of Seed-to-next-stage advancement in the sector, this method implies an $8M valuation. This single-method triangulation establishes a range of $6M to $9M, with $8M as the median point. The $6M floor reflects downside scenarios assuming below-median progression factors, while the $9M ceiling reflects above-median execution or market-expansion multiples.

Key uncertainties include the absence of narrow-peer comparables, which limits cross-validation of the stage-progression assumption. The reliance on a single quantitative method and the capital-raised proxy introduces material modeling risk. Additional specificity on revenue, unit economics, or market-size metrics would materially improve confidence in this range. Current data supports a median valuation near $8M, pending refinement as the company progresses toward Series A.
